skills.summary: Turn a spec into a checkpointed build plan
skills.job: Turn an approved spec into an ordered implementation plan with checkpoints and verification per step
triggers: write an implementation plan for this spec
plan out how to build this
break this spec into ordered steps
gotchas: steps ordered by file instead of by what can be verified
no checkpoint so a wrong early step poisons the rest
plan names files and functions that were never looked up

skills.summary: Explore intent and options before building
skills.job: Pin down what the user wants and weigh options before any design or code starts, asking before assuming
triggers: I want to build something, help me think it through
before we start what should we consider
what are my options for this feature
gotchas: asking five questions at once instead of the one that unblocks
presenting one option dressed up as three
starting to design before the real goal is stated

skills.summary: Write a clear spec for a feature or change
skills.job: Write a spec that states problem, scope, behaviour, edge cases and open questions so a builder needs no guesses
triggers: write a spec for this feature
spec this out before we code
turn my idea into a requirements doc
gotchas: describing the solution with no stated problem
behaviour left as 'handles errors' with no cases
open questions buried in prose instead of listed

skills.job: Write an architecture decision record with context, options, decision and consequences, filed in the repo
triggers: write an ADR for this decision
document why we chose this
record this architecture decision
gotchas: recording the choice but not the rejected options
consequences that list only upsides
rewriting an old ADR instead of superseding it

skills.summary: Estimate effort with ranges and assumptions
skills.job: Estimate a piece of work as a range from broken-down parts, with assumptions and unknowns stated
triggers: how long will this take
estimate this feature
give me a rough size for this task
gotchas: one number with no range
estimating the coding and forgetting review, tests and integration
anchoring on the number the asker hoped for

skills.summary: Cut scope to a shippable first version
skills.job: Trim a feature list to the smallest version that still delivers the core value, with cuts parked not lost
triggers: this is too big, what can we cut
what is the MVP here
help me descope this
gotchas: cutting the riskiest part because it is hard
cutting work that later forces a rewrite
dropping items silently instead of listing them as deferred

skills.summary: List project risks with owners and responses
skills.job: Build a risk register that ranks risks by likelihood and impact and names a trigger and response for each
triggers: what could go wrong with this plan
make a risk register
list the risks for this project
gotchas: generic risks that apply to any project
no trigger so nobody knows when a risk has happened
mitigation that is only 'monitor'

skills.summary: Split a goal into small verifiable tasks
skills.job: Split a feature or goal into small tasks, each with a done check and explicit dependencies
triggers: break this down into tasks
split this epic into tickets
what are the subtasks for this
gotchas: tasks sized by guess, several days with no done check
hidden dependencies that block the first task picked
horizontal slices that deliver nothing until all are done

skills.job: Answer one technical unknown with a time-boxed experiment and report a recommendation backed by evidence
triggers: do a spike on this
can we do this with library X, find out
investigate feasibility before we commit
gotchas: no written question so the spike wanders
spike code left behind and shipped as production
reporting what was learned without a recommendation

skills.job: Write a technical design document covering goals, architecture, data, interfaces, alternatives and rollout
triggers: write a design doc for this
document the technical design
design this system before building it
gotchas: architecture diagram prose with no data model or interfaces
alternatives section that strawmans the options
no rollout or migration story

skills.job: Write acceptance criteria for a story as concrete, testable checks including failure and edge cases
triggers: write acceptance criteria for this story
how do we know this is done
define done for this ticket
gotchas: criteria like 'works well' that no test can fail
only the happy path covered
criteria that dictate implementation instead of behaviour
